notes: Runtime captures of `next start` (production build of site/) with NEXT_PUBLIC_COMMITTED_RELAY_URL pointed at a local stub of the relay's GET /v1/race. The stub serves fixed calendars (fictional rivals ezra-q, odile-m and ana; addisonk is the site's existing demo handle) and works out the lead with the relay's own rules; ghost is unknown, so the relay answers 404. The error page is 393 × 852. OG images are the route's opengraph-image PNGs (1200 × 630) fetched from the same server. Windows reads "coming soon" because NEXT_PUBLIC_WINDOWS_DOWNLOAD_AVAILABLE was unset, as in production until the Windows release. No before state: the page is new.
